name: Turkcell Avrupa Veri Merkezi (Turkcell Europe Data Center)
notes: Opened 13 Sep 2021 in Kapakli district, Karaagac OSB (Tekirdag) with Minister Adil Karaismailoglu; ~37,277 sqm site / ~43,000 sqm closed area / ~7,238 sqm white space across 3 modules, Tier III certified, LEED Gold, ~16 MW total; construction started 08.03.2019 (Serban project page). Re-verified via AA + BTK official + contractor pages. No additional Tekirdag/Corlu/Kapakli datacenter project found in this run; Google Cloud-Turkcell Turkiye cloud region remains announced (coming, not live) with no Tekirdag physical site confirmation.
